status: pre-commit — model and unit specified before the test is run
question: Does channel composition of forgetting show a γ × condition interaction on the registered grid?

unit.name: unique (arrangement, init) draw
unit.on_this_grid: init seed 0-7. stream_id was unread, so 40 files per (γ, condition) cell are 8 unique draws each written five times. Deduplicate with unique_recs: one file per (γ, condition, seed, N).

population.note: Same cell as Figure 2 (task 0, lag 12). All four corners, including S-HH, because the headline is γ × condition, not three-corner pooled composition.

primary.name: signed utility term of Δ log α
primary.why: Additive piece of the identity, defined at every γ including where |Δ log α| is below the Figure 2 two-floor gate. Shares of an unresolved change are not a composition of forgetting.

headline_share.name: per-unit utility share |term| / Σ|term|
headline_share.gate: include a draw only if |Δ log α| ≥ 2 alpha noise floors (Figure 2 MIN_FLOORS). Restrict the share ANOVA to the largest set of γ at which every (γ, condition) cell keeps n ≥ 6 after the gate; if no such set exists with at least two γ, report the share ANOVA as not licensed and stop.
headline_share.why_not_primary: Shares are undefined-as-forgetting below the gate; gating unbalances the design.

model.primary: balanced two-way ANOVA: y ~ C(γ) * C(condition) on the 6 × 4 × 8 unique draws (signed utility term).
model.interaction_test: F-test of the γ × condition interaction. This is the object.
model.robustness: permutation of condition labels within each (seed, γ), 999 shuffles, two-sided p on the interaction F. Same unique unit.
model.share_anova: same F-test on gated per-unit utility share, on the licensed γ set only.

readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.interaction_p_below_0.05_on_signed_utili: Channel composition's γ-gradient differs by condition. The headline is an interaction, not a γ-main-effect pooled over corners.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.interaction_p_at_or_above_0.05_on_signed: No detectable γ × condition interaction on the utility term at unique n=8. The composition shift with γ is not licensed as corner-specific from this test.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.share_anova_not_licensed: Report that fact. Do not substitute an ungated share test.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.S_HH: Included. Opposite-sign Δ log α in the benign corner is part of the condition factor, not a reason to drop the cell.

will_not_do: Treat five stream_id copies as independent.
Pool the three forgetting corners before testing γ × condition.
Use reserved stream ids (this is a re-analysis of the old population).
